name: UI Tuner
description: Reference plugin for ctx.app: reads and writes the whitelisted display settings (layout, font size, bubble opacity, code-block behaviour, tool-call style). Copy this shape when the model should change how the app looks or behaves from inside a conversation.
author: MyAgent

prompt.text: ui-tuner 提供两个工具用于修改应用界面（不是聊天内容）：ui_get 读取当前显示设置，ui_set 按补丁修改。用户说「界面改简洁一点」「字号大一点」「关掉代码块折叠」「换个工具调用样式」这类要求时，先 ui_get 看当前值，再 ui_set 传最小补丁，然后把真正生效的字段告诉用户。只改用户点到的方面，不要顺手改别的。可写字段见 ui_get 返回的 writable_keys；模型/API key/provider 不在其中，也不要用别的方式绕。

tools.name: ui_get
tools.description: Read the whitelisted display settings of the app (layout, font size, bubble opacity, code-block behaviour, tool-call style) plus the list of writable keys.

tools.name: ui_set
tools.description: Apply a patch to the app's display settings. Only whitelisted keys take effect; numbers are clamped to sane ranges and unknown keys are ignored. Returns which keys were actually changed.
